messages:
Carla R: Proposed concise migration: operator issues ephemeral client certs per-tenant, staged by region. Fallback to regional shared endpoint.
Alice M: Main risk: customers that rely on preserved src IP. Per-tenant peering preserves it but costs more and grows route tables.
Brian W: +1. Recommend gating per-tenant peering to paid SLA tier and defaulting to shared endpoint with documented SNAT behavior.
Matt K: Air-gapped flow: customer generates CSR locally, operator signs offline, agent loads cert. TTL longer (24h) for offline certs.
Carla R: Online flow: operator requests short-lived certs (1h) from KMS, pushes to agent, agent auto-renews.
Jen S: Rollout plan: (1) observe-only for 2w, (2) canary 8 non-prod tenants in one region, (3) nightly regional ramps, (4) enable proxy auto-fallback on handshake spike.
Alice M: DNS: set TTL=30s during cutovers but add circuit-breaker for clients that ignore TTLs.
sre-bot: Draft alerts: controlplane.handshake.error_rate > 1% (5m), operator.cert_renew.failures, peer.route_churn high.
Carla R: Operator API sketch: POST /operator/tenants/:id/bootstrap -> token; POST /.../certs -> create; PUT -> renew; DELETE -> revoke.
Brian W: I'll produce cost delta estimate and gating recommendation by Tue EOD.
Matt K: I'll own offline docs and agent compatibility matrix (agent v2.1+ requirement for cutover).
Carla R: I'll open RFC follow-up with API spec + runbook after feedback. If no objections in 24h, we convert to PR.
